title: Branches
subtitle: Each branch has exactly one branch manager and one cashier.
codeHint: 2–4 letters, used in order numbers (e.g. GH-000042). Can't be changed later.
name: Name (English)
inactiveHint: Inactive branches can't use the showroom.
createHint: The manager and cashier accounts are created together with the branch.
replaceBody: {name}'s account is closed and a new account is created in its place. This can't be undone.
codeTaken: A branch with this code already exists.
replaceHint: Enter the new person's details. Their username and passwords are generated.
pinBody: The 6-digit PIN the showroom screen of this branch signs in with. Screens signed in with the old PIN are signed out.
pinMismatch: The two PINs are not the same.
pinHint: Not shown again after saving. Keep it with the branch staff.
